stages.title: Workstation feasibility and implementation decisions
stages.goal: Make an actionable, reviewed environment/tool/model plan without claiming a deployment.
scope: Read-only workstation inventory when this stage is authorized; redact serial numbers, private account details and unrelated paths.
Verify available Docker/Kubernetes/CNI/proxy/issuer candidates and current model metadata without automatically starting, loading or downloading a model.
Propose tested version pins, resource allocation, isolated names/ports and actual-account retention/reviewer arrangements.
demo_steps: Show the redacted doctor report and explicit unknowns.
Show a reproducible decision/pin matrix for uv/Ruff/Python and Node/pnpm/frontend tooling.
Locate the user-selected google/gemma-4-12b-qat metadata if accessible; distinguish downloaded, loaded and function-admitted.
adverse_tests: Unavailable listener/model metadata remains unknown; no automatic alternate model or server start.
Insufficient resources does not increase capacity limits or silently select remote hosting.
critical_risks: Unknown host fit and network enforcement
Unresolved actual-account retention
Model metadata and capability unverified
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Accept the concrete tool/version/environment proposal and scoped next-stage setup actions, or request changes. Existing workstation/model choices are not reopened.
stages.rollback: Read-only stage leaves host state unchanged; discard only generated redacted reports if explicitly requested.

stages.title: Repository foundation and contract walking skeleton
stages.goal: Create a reproducible modular development loop with a visible contract demonstration.
scope: Create uv and pnpm workspaces, typed package boundaries, locked dependencies and root command catalog.
Implement schema adapters/parity tests and isolated API/UI skeleton; no participant admission or fake business success.
Create CI fast checks and build minimal per-service images for an authorized disposable lab.
demo_steps: From a clean checkout run the documented locked setup and checks.
Open the EN/FR developer shell and show a typed health/capability result.
Submit an unknown nested key and an overflowing revision; show both Python and TypeScript adapters reject the same inputs.
adverse_tests: Lockfile/manifest mismatch fails instead of resolving silently.
A forbidden runtime-to-data import or a schema loosening fails the check.
Unimplemented operations return explicit capability-unavailable responses rather than synthetic success.
deliverables: Minimal role shell and typed capability UI
CI fast lane and clean-build evidence
critical_risks: Generated bindings may weaken closed schemas
Shared development environment mistaken for deployment isolation
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Accept the developer demonstration and reproducible command surface; no participant-use or deployment approval is inferred.
stages.rollback: Revert candidate files/locks together; retain the last verified development baseline and do not touch source repositories.

stages.title: Identity, workload trust and independent help/static paths
stages.goal: Prove private access boundaries and an honest fallback on this workstation.
scope: Implement OIDC/BFF/MFA and scoped role sessions; establish attested proxy identity and actual default-deny routes.
Implement host help/spool with fresh request-bound identity decisions and separate static publication.
Resolve account-retention scope and current independently reviewed fallback content before participant use.
Pin the applicable identity/network standard controls and local-control test mapping before accepting those implemented boundaries; full register completion remains IMP-08.
demo_steps: Use separate browser profiles for participant and worker identities; direct unauthorized role/API access is denied.
Create an opaque help request, accept it and show accepted_unconnected.
Stop the main lab cluster: static survives; if identity is lost, private help becomes unavailable without cached permission.
adverse_tests: Forged/replayed/expired login or help proof fails.
Direct backend/DB/model/internet/alternate host-port probes from runtime fail.
Expired workload credential and compromised open connection cannot retain permission.
Use a known-active isolated control listener and allowed caller; refusal from an absent server is not credited as denied-route proof.
deliverables: Identity/assurance adapter and credential lifecycle tests
Independent help/static processes and publication evidence
critical_risks: Private help incorrectly claimed independent of identity
Loopback/sidecar mistaken for enforced peer identity
Real account metadata governed as synthetic
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Review login/help/fallback and denied-route demonstrations. Accept only the observed environment scope; unverified content or trust keeps participant admission disabled.
stages.rollback: Fence candidate private listeners/identities, retain reviewed static publication, remove only named disposable resources after explicit confirmation of target scope.

stages.title: Usable protected manual client-to-worker service
stages.goal: Deliver the first complete useful actor journey without relying on AI.
scope: Implement guarded business/control/audit transactions, current PDP checks, bootstrap signed policy and recovery-journal barrier from the first protected write.
Implement disclosure, synthetic persona/session, attributed turns, deterministic fixture escalation, queue/assignment and two-party handoff.
Implement owner fencing, SSE current projections, operation reconciliation and explicit continuation recovery.
Establish scoped encrypted backup/capture hooks for the first durable state; integrated trusted restore/serving proof remains IMP-09 and unproven protection is visible.
demo_steps: Participant enters a fictional case, asks for a human and connects to a worker through current two-party confirmation.
Worker reads only assigned context and sends a manual message; supervisor takeover changes control epoch.
Disable AI, then lose a continuation replacement response and recover with fresh same-principal proof.
adverse_tests: Race two worker accepts and pause old output during takeover: exactly one owner and no stale future output.
Audit/PDP/journal failure releases no protected success; independent help/static behavior remains truthful.
Silence/disconnect does not close unresolved support; lost DB acknowledgement reconciles one logical operation.
deliverables: Canonical audit and current policy/journal foundations
Separate actor UIs and manual smoke scenario
Initial backup/capture and restore-to-quarantine harness; no serving-recovery claim yet
critical_risks: Audit or journal deferred until later stage
Acceptance confused with connection
Authority checked only on login
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Demonstrate normal manual service and adverse ownership/audit behavior. Human acceptance establishes this bounded baseline, not full-demo or clinical readiness.
stages.rollback: Keep schema-compatible last-known-good manual path; restrict protected service if current authority cannot be established. Never rewind live rights or erase unresolved cases.

stages.title: Attributed plans, sourced options and granular consent
stages.goal: Support client-led planning and service choice without leaking another actor’s private context.
scope: Implement PID/carer attribution, disputes, plan fields/retirement/sharing and current field filtering.
Implement all seven directory operating states plus source freshness/quarantine/suspension.
Implement purpose/recipient/field/time/assurance consent and journalled revocation.
demo_steps: PID creates and shares selected plan fields; carer sees only those fields and own reports.
Exercise normal, closure, outage, holiday, weather, API failure and conflicting-source options with truthful alternatives/unknowns.
Revoke sharing while a stream/task is pending; later disclosure stops and the UI explains missing access.
adverse_tests: Relationship/professional-participant role does not grant PID/workforce authority.
An absent-grant concurrent creation/revoke race uses the existing subject guard.
Expired/stale/conflicting directory information cannot imply availability or a new executable destination.
deliverables: Consent/field filtering and revocation race evidence
critical_risks: Guardian/carer authority laundering
Source admission confused with operating availability
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Review exact field-level views and revoke/unknown-state demonstrations using separate accounts; accept the scoped privacy behavior.
stages.rollback: Disable affected plan/share/option capability if filtering fails; retain current negative rights and the accepted manual service.

stages.title: Reviewed simulated referral and receiver reconciliation
stages.goal: Complete client→worker→receiving-service work with exact consent and honest delivery states.
scope: Implement manual unsent drafts, exact payload review, immutable generations and current dispatch authorization.
Implement stable dispatch IDs, consumed authorization, outbox attempts/receipts and receiver-owned decisions.
Add receiver inbox and bounded scenario controls; no real contacts or external connectors.
demo_steps: Client supplies exact consent; worker reviews fields/purpose/recipient/digest and sends to isolated receiver.
Receiver partially accepts or refuses; worker sees the actual receipt and keeps client support active.
Drop the response after receiver storage; reconcile by dispatch ID with no duplicate package.
adverse_tests: Revoke/change policy/assignment/source between PDP evaluation and final authorization: stale send is absent.
Timeout, generic receipt unavailable and partial result never become accepted/connected by inference.
Changed payload under an existing key is rejected; machine emergency/police target remains absent/denied.
critical_risks: Enqueue-time permit reused for send
Unknown delivery retried as a new logical effect
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Demonstrate exact review, before/after-authorization revocation and dropped-reply reconciliation. Human acceptance concerns simulator behavior only.
stages.rollback: Fence unsent work; retain unknown in-flight attempts for reconciliation. Roll back only compatible code, never rewrite receipt/consent history.

stages.title: Useful bounded AI assistance on the selected local model
stages.goal: Add optional source-linked assistance to an already usable manual workflow.
scope: Implement task profiles/bindings, shared counters, step leases/fences, typed tools, server-built context and human draft review.
Integrate broker→gateway→host bridge→LM Studio google/gemma-4-12b-qat with verified identity/token accounting and function-specific admission.
Keep timeout/cancel compute slots occupied until completion/stop is actually established; preserve manual capacity.
Verify pinned applicable OWASP/ATLAS identifiers and per-function threat/test mapping before affected AI function admission; do not defer this to the final console stage.
demo_steps: Compare the same fictional case actor-only versus assisted; show retrieved sources, draft edits/rejection, bounded observations and receipt follow-through.
Reject every suggestion and complete the manual workflow.
Timeout generation while compute continues: stale output is fenced and manual service continues.
adverse_tests: Prompt/tool/source injection cannot create authority, arbitrary network access or direct runtime inference.
Lease reclaim/restart does not reset step/tool/proposal budgets.
Changed sources/payload/epoch invalidate review; unsupported function stays disabled without swapping model.
deliverables: Fixed local inference adapter and model manifest
critical_risks: Downloaded model mistaken for capable/loaded model
Human review treated as proof of accuracy
Timeout mistaken for released compute
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Review actual source-linked usefulness, seeded errors and outage behavior. Admit only demonstrated functions; record unadmitted functions as explicit remaining scope.
stages.rollback: Disable AI functions/prompt/model bundle under current control epoch; preserve manual service, current rights and independently available fallback.

stages.title: Post-crisis inbox, lifecycle, exports and deletion
stages.goal: Close the supported synthetic workflow with truthful follow-up and rights processing.
scope: Implement explicit post-crisis anchor/pending state, separate contact consent, internal inbox, cancellation and attributed outcomes.
Implement copy inventory/anchors/dependencies/holds, guarded purge, current-authorized export and faster verified deletion targets.
Keep backup-dependent completion pending until recovery/expiry evidence in IMP-09; no false physical-erasure claim.
demo_steps: Schedule a follow-up within the explicit 24–72h anchor window, then opt out before authorization and show no inbox delivery.
Show an active plan surviving session expiry under its own purpose, and a held dependent copy with an explicit exception.
Export only own permitted reports; delete eligible active content while backup status remains accurately pending.
adverse_tests: Missing anchor/cyclic dependency/hold blocks unsafe purge; two tabs cannot bypass AL3 cooling and fresh proof.
Unknown inbox send requires durable absence plus old-sender fencing before reauthorization.
Carer own-data rights do not export/delete PID or other-author private content.
deliverables: Rights/copy graph/race evidence and pending-backup reporting
critical_risks: Synthetic TTL applied to real account metadata
File unlink reported as physical erasure
Pending backup falsely reported complete
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Review cancellation, own-data export, active purge and retained-exception demos. Accept only the proven active-copy scope; backup erasure remains a later obligation.
stages.rollback: Stop purge/delivery jobs and preserve restrictions/holds. Never restore deleted content to simplify rollback; use quarantined recovery if necessary.

stages.title: Operational governance, security and accountable evidence consoles
stages.goal: Expose and verify controlled live change, scoped containment and honest operational evidence.
scope: Complete class-specific artifact/reviewer registry, signed activation/ACK/rollback, exceptions and incident controls on top of IMP-03 enforcement.
Implement operator/security/governance/auditor workspaces, current scoped evidence and coupled suppressed aggregate reports.
Add drift/resource/identity response drills; pin exact applicable standards identifiers from official artifacts.
demo_steps: Propose a changed policy/artifact, show missing reviews, then activate exact approved bytes and current per-boot ACKs.
Introduce a restrictive update while an operation is paused and show the old permit cannot execute.
Show bounded containment, desired/current epochs, coupled metrics and no individual exposure export.
adverse_tests: Two accounts for one human cannot self-approve; expired exception/old ACK/rollback cannot restore rights.
Missing audit/current state denies effects; telemetry or a classifier never grants permission.
Small cohort/differencing and isolated police-avoidance export are denied/suppressed.
deliverables: Pinned standards/control evidence map and aggregate disclosure tests
critical_risks: Monitoring substituted for inline control
Agent review mistaken for human approval
Framework mapping mistaken for certification
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Review live restrictive/relaxing change, independent approval separation and containment/metrics demos; accept only the observed authorities and environment.
stages.rollback: Use a new controlled epoch selecting a compatible previous bundle; retain newest revokes/deletes/holds and independent serving ownership.

stages.title: Backup, current-authority restore and serving promotion
stages.goal: Prove that old snapshots cannot resurrect revoked rights and that cutover cannot create two serving generations.
scope: Implement encrypted backup inventory/checkpoints, immutable expiry and isolated restore targets.
Reconcile live host journal/rights/holds/unknown sends, seal target evidence and obtain distinct human serving approval.
Test maintenance/old-generation fence/router/target enable/smoke interruptions and measure full RPO/RTO.
demo_steps: Restore an old snapshot containing revoked/deleted/shared data into quarantine; verify current restrictions before any serving.
Change the current head after approval; show promotion is rejected until revalidated/reviewed.
Crash during cutover and show both generations remain restricted until one current generation is established.
adverse_tests: Missing/corrupt/suspect head cannot be replaced by an old signature/time/sequence.
No stale continuation/bearer/lease/review/dispatch authorization becomes active on restore.
Restoring a backup does not renew expiry; uncertain send reconciliation creates no duplicate effect.
deliverables: Separate approver evidence bound to exact target/head
Crash matrix, deletion/retention restore proof and measured RPO/RTO
critical_risks: Old snapshot certifies its own current rights
Router switch mistaken for generation fencing
Same host claimed independent of root/disaster
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Review stale-head and interrupted-cutover demonstrations. A drill acceptance is not approval of future restores; each actual serving promotion retains its own exact human decision.
stages.rollback: Keep protected serving quarantined. Reconcile gate/router/DB under restriction and use a newly validated compatible target, never blind rewind.

stages.title: Integrated demonstrator acceptance and sustainable delivery
stages.goal: Present a complete bounded demonstrator with reproducible evidence and remaining limitations.
scope: Run all actor journeys/use cases, applicable invariant/adverse suites, EN/FR accessibility and internal channel/training scenarios.
Measure declared workstation load, failures/cold-warm model behavior and actor-only/assisted outcomes with raw missingness.
Reconcile every local/source requirement disposition, reproducibility, LKG, runbooks and independent human review.
demo_steps: Run the full client→worker→receiver→plan/follow-up/rights journey across separate profiles and show real observations.
Disable model/policy/audit/identity/cluster in turn and show only capabilities whose dependencies survive.
Have the human follow the published demo/runbook from a clean candidate with exact artifact/source/config pins.
adverse_tests: No critical authorization bypass, false connection/outcome or concealed unmet obligation is acceptable.
Real channels/partners/clinical capability/production readiness remain excluded or deferred explicitly.
A changed candidate or environment invalidates stale acceptance.
deliverables: Human acceptance/candidate release record and compatible rollback
critical_risks: Document/schema counts mistaken for implemented coverage
Synthetic evaluation promoted to clinical evidence
stages.human_decision: Deferred until after IMP-10 through GitHub issue follow-up; not an implementation qualification prerequisite. Original review scope: Accept the exact synthetic-demo candidate, request rework or accept a clearly narrowed scope with recorded remaining obligations. Never infer production/clinical approval.
stages.rollback: Retain last verified accepted candidate if current and compatible; otherwise restrict private service and retain independent static information. Preserve all current rights.
